result.summary: C1 learned source preservation and restored transfer seed agreement to 0.982-0.998 with only 13-20 changes, but legacy behavior labels caused 10-12 unsupported all-ins. C2 allowed only replicated rows to teach behavior; all seeds became exact source-equivalent with 100% agreement and zero unsupported all-ins, but changed zero actions because only 11 replicated changed examples existed.
result.conclusion: Do not externally evaluate either posterior32 checkpoint, re-enable legacy behavior supervision, or tune coefficients on the same 11 changed examples.
result.next_step: Use the in-flight posterior128x2 replicated dataset with the evidence-scoped MoE contract and repeat independent transfer, cross-seed, unsupported-all-in and worst-tail gates.
